answer: To resist Sybils an agent must first grow a private grove of 9 sequential delay functions whose outputs chain by hash, requiring 72 unbroken hours no fee can compress. A bridge of violet spectral probes then samples pairwise fingerprints; any pair closer than 0.15 Hamming distance is treated as one identity and both bonds are burned. A farm of 40 clones therefore pays 40 full 72-hour waits rather than one amortized run.
